an5.169:1.1: athakho āyasmā ānando yenāyasmā sāriputto tenusaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
an5.169:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an5.169:2.1: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso sāriputta bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu suggahitaggāhī ca bahuñca gaṇhāti gahitañcassa nappamussatīti
an5.169:2.4: tenahāvuso sāriputta suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
an5.169:2.5: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
an5.169:3.1: idhāvuso sāriputta bhikkhu atthakusalo ca hoti dhammakusalo ca byañjanakusalo ca niruttikusalo ca pubbāparakusalo ca
an5.169:3.2: ettāvatā kho āvuso sāriputta bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu suggahitaggāhī ca bahuñca gaṇhāti gahitañcassa nappamussatīti
an5.169:3.5: imehi ca mayaṃ pañcahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dhārema
an5.169:3.6: āyasmā ānando atthakusalo dhammakusalo byañjanakusalo niruttikusalo pubbāparakusaloti.
